targetFidelity: 1:1 original1990 MSX2 incarnation, closest_supported when source pixels cannot resolve detail

excluded: Metal Gear Solid3 Subsistence 2005 graphical/portrait edits

nativeSpriteContract.bodyCompleteness: Every frame includes the complete anatomical body, boots and held equipment without edge clipping or neighbouring pose pixels; renderer contours may select native pixels but never alter the PNG.
reviewRequirements: Inspect all six unmodified native sheets and original references physically.
Check left/right anatomy and costume against supported source asymmetry; invent no hidden asymmetry.
Check every crop in actual browser Canvas, both orientations and 1280/390 viewports.
Check first active source frame and source SHA before measuring launch coordinates.
Preserve every attempt, rejection, source PNG, prompt, metadata, reference and failure log.
Do not repurpose a rejected canonical design as an OC. PARALLAXE remains the sole user-authorized Viper reject OC.
nativeSpriteContract.sourceFamily: new independent transparent native atlas, original tiny sprite palette/silhouette guide; not an upscaled/resized original PNG

mechanicPolicy: Original costume, silhouette, palette and supported abilities guide art. Versus normals, finishers, costs, damage, phase timing, collision, bounded concealment and balance are explicitly adaptations. Recovered raw profiles remain untouched; corrections belong to scoped new helpers after root approval.
sourceEvidenceLimits: Original Japanese1990 manual scan establishes names and documented lore.

LP screenshots preserve original MSX2 visual era and English dialogue, but the translation patch/emulator/ROM version was not independently verified. They are not claimed unmodified Japanese1990 game executions.
English LP codec transcription is secondary evidence, not a certified verbatim original-language script.
Tiny sprite mirrors establish limited pixel palette/silhouette by comparison; extracted-native provenance and any prior nearest-neighbour enlargement are not certified.
rawSnapshots: Parsed object snapshots preserve all values from pinned original raw JSON; serialization whitespace is new and these files are not claimed byte slices of the original files.
futureIntegrationAuthorization: This subtask is limited to preparation under /workspace/cqc-pass8-reference-selection. No generation, catalog change, R/S mutation, Git write or deployment was performed.
identity: Original MSX2 Predator; runtime UID/display alias retained for compatibility, do not substitute the film Predator.
visualSupported: Original PREDAT game capture identifies green human opponent holding a long dark firearm in a yellow crop/wheat field with hay bales.

Tiny mirrored sprite shows green covered head and green upper body over dark silhouette with long black firearm; exact features remain unresolved. Pink matte pixels in mirror are not costume or canonical background.
weaponSupported: A conventional long firearm silhouette is visible in original capture lp36-23-Metal_Gear_2_1205.png and tiny mirrored sprite.
Manual states ambush/guerrilla specialist. It does not certify the gun model, caliber, ammunition feed or a grenade weapon.
The LP author speculates flamethrower in commentary, while secondary page calls an assault rifle. Neither is promoted to original model evidence without inspected firing frames.
mechanicsSupported: Original manual page42 supports guerrilla ambush and an assassin without form.
Game captures show the green opponent alternating visible/hidden in the crop field. This supports terrain concealment, not proof of optical invisibility technology.
correctionsNeeded: Do not retain specialDown grenade as canonical without direct proof. Prefer adapted hide/brace or conventional shot after final source review.
Replace generic invisible-body cloak presentation with terrain/low-profile concealment adaptation; no magical invisibility or cyborg powers.
Do not generate flame jets, sci-fi plasma, exact gun-brand marks or a backpack fuel tank from speculative commentary.
unknowns: Exact rifle type and firing effect: source video was blocked and no firing frame was inspected.
Real face, hair, realistic skin tone, gloves and ammunition-feed details.
Standing side views and original left/right costume asymmetry.
originPlan: Once exact first active pose is generated and physically inspected, measure the end of the conventional gun barrel for each independent face. Generic barrel geometry remains an authored closest-supported interpretation; no original exact model claim.
